user.title: Brother P-touch
user.description: How is the printer reachable from Home Assistant?

menu_options.usb: USB cable to the Home Assistant host
menu_options.bluetooth: Bluetooth from the Home Assistant host (scan and pair)
menu_options.bridge: HTTP bridge running next to the printer

usb.title: USB
usb.description: Plug the printer into the Home Assistant host and switch it on. Leave the serial empty unless you have several printers.

discovery_confirm.description: A Brother P-touch printer was found on USB. Set it up?

bluetooth_scan.title: Searching for printers
bluetooth_scan.description: Switch the printer on, disconnect any phone from it and keep it close to the Home Assistant host.

bluetooth_pick.title: Choose your printer
bluetooth_pick.description: Pick the printer from the list. Printers are listed first. If it is not paired yet, Home Assistant pairs it for you (PIN 0000).

bluetooth_manual.title: Bluetooth address
bluetooth_manual.description:
{explanation}

Pair the printer with the host first (bluetoothctl). Enter its MAC address, or a device path such as /dev/rfcomm0 or /dev/usb/lp0.

error.cannot_connect: Could not talk to the printer. Check power, cabling/pairing and that no other program is using it.
error.asleep: The printer isn't answering. Press its power button to switch it on, make sure no phone is connected to it, then try again.
error.busy: The printer is connected to something else (a phone?). Disconnect it and try again.
error.not_paired: This printer isn't paired with Home Assistant yet.
error.bluetooth_off: Bluetooth is switched off on the Home Assistant host.
error.bluetooth_unavailable: Home Assistant can't use Bluetooth here. Use USB or the network bridge, or enter the address manually.
error.pairing_failed: Pairing failed. Check that the printer is on and try again.
error.pairing_timeout: Pairing took too long. Make sure the printer is on and close by, then try again.
error.device_not_found: The printer was not found. Switch it on and scan again.
error.no_devices: No Bluetooth devices were found. Switch the printer on and scan again, or enter the address manually.
error.no_device_selected: Choose a printer, or tick one of the other options.
error.invalid_address: That is not a valid Bluetooth address (expected AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF).

abort.cannot_connect: Could not talk to the printer: {message}

progress.scanning: Scanning for Bluetooth devices. This takes about 10 seconds.
progress.pairing: Pairing with {name}. Keep the printer switched on and close to the host; if it asks for a PIN, it is 0000.

init.title: Printing
init.description: If your first test label comes out mirrored or upside down, pick the setting that fixes it.

data_description.batch_window: Labels requested within this many seconds of each other print as one continuous strip with a single cut, which saves tape. 0 prints every request on its own.
data_description.wake_seconds: How long printing and the Connect button keep trying to reach a sleeping Bluetooth printer. 0 tries once.

print_text.name: Print text
print_text.description: Print one or more lines of text. Font size is chosen automatically unless set.

device_id.name: Printer
device_id.description: Needed only if you have more than one printer.

text.name: Text
text.description: Text to print; use new lines for multiple lines.

font_size.name: Font size
font_size.description: Pixels (180 dpi). Leave empty to auto-fit the tape.

font.name: Font file
font.description: Path to a .ttf file (must be in allowlist_external_dirs).

auto_cut.name: Auto cut
auto_cut.description: Cut at the end of the job.

cut_each.name: Cut each label
cut_each.description: With several copies, cut after every label instead of printing one continuous strip. Wastes tape.

chain.name: Chain labels
chain.description: Don't feed the tape out at the end, so the next label follows right after this one. The label stays in the printer until the next print or Feed tape.

cut_mark.name: Cut marks
cut_mark.description: Printers without a cutter: print a cut mark after every label.

margin_mm.name: Feed margin
margin_mm.description: Blank tape fed before/after the label.
